heroTitle: Getting to Know the 6 Villages of Enggano
heroSubtitle: Explore the cultural diversity and natural charm of the six settlements that are the heartbeat of life on the front line of the Indian Ocean.
mapSubtitle: Interactive map based on OpenStreetMap with a focus on the Enggano Island area.
villagesSubtitle: Explore six villages that are the pillars of life on Enggano Island, each with unique cultural and natural charm.
tribesSubtitle: Get to know the six indigenous and migrant tribes that built civilization and passed down local wisdom on Enggano Island.

kahyapu.name: Kahyapu
kahyapu.summary: The sea gateway of Enggano with the main port that was the center of early economic activity.

kaana.name: Kaana
kaana.summary: Known for its coastal beauty and agrarian community that preserves ancestral traditions.

malakoni.name: Malakoni
malakoni.summary: The center of government and the pulse of the community, a meeting place for various local tribes.

apoho.name: Apoho
apoho.summary: Hidden in the dense forest, this village holds stunning endemic flora and fauna.

meok.name: Meok
meok.summary: A fishing village with the longest coastline, offering endless ocean views.

enggano.name: Enggano
enggano.summary: Carrying the island's name, this village preserves historical sites and oral stories of the past.
